transcript.statement: The safety of the autonomous driving system is paramount. SAF-01 ensures a robust multi-layer safety architecture essential for collision protection and fail-safe operations. SAF-02 mandates the execution of a Minimal Risk Maneuver (MRM) within 5 seconds to safely address critical failures, crucial for passenger safety. SAF-03 emphasizes continuous monitoring of the Operational Design Domain (ODD) for proactive risk management. SAF-04, SAF-05, and SAF-06 address passenger comfort and vehicle stability, while SAF-07 establishes protocols for relaxing smoothness constraints during emergencies, ensuring safety first. These requirements collectively prioritize safety and reliability in all operational scenarios.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is critical for the autonomous driving system. EFF-01 aims for a 30% travel time reduction, enhancing overall efficiency. EFF-02 ensures passenger comfort by maintaining jerk below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation. EFF-03 emphasizes executing MRMs within 5 seconds while balancing performance. EFF-04 ensures real-time ODD compliance monitoring with minimal latency, and EFF-05 targets high success rates in optimal speed profile generation. EFF-06 focuses on rapid processing for non-convex obstacle constraints, and EFF-07 prioritizes smoothness during emergencies. Collectively, these requirements ensure the system operates effectively and responsively in various scenarios.

transcript.statement: The ethical and compliance aspects of the autonomous driving system are essential for ensuring accountability and adherence to regulations. RES-01 mandates compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all times. RES-02 establishes a multi-layer safety architecture for active monitoring and response to failures. RES-03 ensures MRMs are executed promptly to guarantee safety. RES-04 and RES-05 reinforce continuous monitoring of ODD compliance and timely human takeover requests. RES-06 prioritizes passenger safety over comfort during emergencies, and RES-07 ensures documentation for accountability. These requirements collectively uphold ethical standards and regulatory compliance, crucial for public trust.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is critical for the autonomous driving system to minimize environmental impact. transcript.statement: The Trustworthiness dimension is essential for the autonomous driving system to ensure security and privacy of user data. TRU-01 mandates end-to-end data encryption for all user data, safeguarding privacy and integrity. TRU-02 establishes role-based access control to restrict permissions, enhancing security. TRU-03 ensures auditability by logging access and modifications to critical data. TRU-04 incorporates data anonymization techniques to protect identities. TRU-05 emphasizes regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities, while TRU-06 provides a secure mechanism for remote software updates. Finally, TRU-07 ensures transparency around data collection, fostering user trust. These requirements collectively uphold security, privacy, and integrity, which are paramount in autonomous systems.

requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms to ensure collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds upon detecting critical system failures while adhering to safety and ethical standards.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue human takeover requests as necessary.
The system shall minimize jerk to less than 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation while allowing for energy-efficient practices during emergencies.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints ($kappa$) to prevent rollover during maneuvers at all speeds.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints with a processing time under 50 milliseconds.
The system shall prioritize ethical responsibilities in balancing smoothness and safety during emergency maneuvers.
The system shall optimize path planning to achieve a minimum 30% reduction in average travel time compared to baseline scenarios.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation to enhance passenger comfort.
The system shall achieve at least 95% success rate in optimal speed profile generation during path planning.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted to protect privacy and ensure data integrity.
The system shall enforce role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their role within the system.
The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture that guarantees active monitoring and response to critical system failures.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions for accountability and regulatory purposes.
